SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   C. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)

   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
